remarks: Wonderful updated two-bedroom condominium located in the desirable Winnipauk Village community. The main level offers a well-appointed kitchen and an open-concept living and dining area with a fireplace, a convenient half bath, and sliding doors that lead to a private deck-ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The upper level features two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, washer and dryer, and pull-down attic access for additional storage. Residents enjoy an impressive array of amenities, including a clubhouse with fitness center, two swimming pools, tennis/pickleball courts, and a racquetball court. The unit includes one reserved parking space plus one visitor space, along with ample additional guest parking. Conveniently located near shopping, parks, and public transportation, with easy access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and the train station. Don't miss this gem.
